comment: The purpose-built hosts of the selection acceptance (scripts/build-selection-hosts.py).
Each host is a real application: its catalogue and its in-application bundles are put in
before it is signed, so a defect is content that was wrong when the seal was made and
the seal itself is never altered. `signing` is developer-id (Koine's identity), or
ad-hoc, whose host verifies no Team ID: an unsigned arm64 executable does not run.
A plugin is a case of Fixtures/FixtureProvider/build-decisions.sh, installed under `as`
(default: the bundle's own name). Fixture signing identifiers are distinct from every
production provider's and are admitted here alone. The catalogue may be an object, or
text for a catalogue that is not JSON at all.

slot.purpose: One enabled slot with its designated baseline, and a reserved-only identity.

slot-no-bundle.purpose: The same catalogue with the designated bundle missing from the application.

slot-bundle-release-mismatch.purpose: The designated bundle carries release 1.0.1; the catalogue says 1.0.0.

slot-bundle-other-identifier.purpose: The designated bundle is signed under an identifier the catalogue does not name.

slot-bundle-adhoc.purpose: The designated bundle is signed ad hoc, inside a properly signed application.

slot-bundle-framework-future.purpose: The designated bundle requires a framework minor this host does not have.

slot-unexpected-bundle.purpose: The designated bundle, and beside it a bundle claiming the reserved pair at release 9.0.0 and an ordinary provider.

slot-missing-with-unexpected.purpose: The designated bundle is missing and only a bundle claiming the reserved pair at release 9.0.0 is inside the application.

two-slots.purpose: Two enabled slots listed in an order that is not their identifier order (fixturesk, then fixturesh).

adhoc-host.purpose: The same application signed ad hoc: no verified Team ID, so no shipped candidate is admitted.

catalogue-malformed.purpose: A catalogue with a key it does not know.

catalogue-conflicting.purpose: A catalogue whose two entries overlap on an identifier and a prefix.

catalogue-partial-baseline.purpose: An enabled entry that states only part of its baseline.

catalogue-truncated.purpose: A catalogue cut off in the middle, so that it is not JSON.
